subject: [SAMPLE] BSides Philly 2026: vendor table + hardware workshop from LSOH
body:
Hi BSides Philly team,

This is a SAMPLE email so you can see how threads look before Gmail is connected.

We'd love to bring a hands-on hardware workshop and a small vendor table to BSides Philly 2026. Who handles sponsor/vendor tables?

Thanks,
LSOH

subject: Re: [SAMPLE] BSides Philly 2026: vendor table + hardware workshop from LSOH
body:
Hey! (SAMPLE reply)

Thanks for reaching out. Our sponsor prospectus is attached; community tables are $250 and include two badges. Workshop proposals go through the CFP in September.

Cheers,
BSides Philly crew

subject: [SAMPLE] JawnCon 0x3 — LSOH hardware village?
body:
Hi JawnCon,

(SAMPLE) We ran a soldering + firmware workshop at a few BSides this spring and would love to set up at JawnCon in October. Is there room for a small village or vendor table?

— LSOH
